metadata.title: SURAT  Food Tour | Part- 2 I Gujarat Food Tour I Indian Street Food
metadata.description:
In this episode, we will take you on a food journey to Rander where the local street food culture has assimilated the Burmese street food - khaosa, then some of the surti innovations like locho, raswala khaman. Moving on to the nonveg delicacies like tapelu, mamna and concluding with rose paan at Ghantewala. Make sure to watch this video till end to enjoy the food ride with Delhi Food Walks.

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
